predecessors.name: Surakarta Sunanate
predecessors.text: Mangkunegaran: its seat in Surakarta and the two named territories, Karanganyar and Wonogiri

successors.name: Republic of Indonesia
successors.text: Mangkunegaran: its seat in Surakarta and the two named territories, Karanganyar and Wonogiri

ledger.x: 19 August 1945: the Mangkunegaran joins the Republic.

certainty.note: The page names no boundary; the appanage was counted in households and the territories were intermixed with Surakarta's.
